tess: Quick repro & UX note: our Kotlin sampleapp shows surprising behavior when a long generate call is cancelled by the user while a token refresh happens concurrently. Instead of canceling immediately, the OkHttp call lingers, the auth refresh waits for a free dispatcher slot, and we sometimes end up with two refresh requests and a retry storm.

omar: Ugh. Which adapter? Are you cancelling the Call when coroutine is cancelled?

tess: We use a small suspend wrapper around Call.enqueue. Current wrapper doesn't call call.cancel() in invokeOnCancellation. Repro: start a 40s streaming generate, navigate back -> coroutine cancelled, but underlying call stays active for a few seconds. Meanwhile a short request triggers 401 -> refresh queued -> duplicate refresh. Logs: 
```
D/SDK: suspend wrapper resumed cancellation
W/OkHttp: call not cancelled; running requests 8/8
D/Auth: refresh request enqueued
E/Auth: concurrent refresh attempted
```

leigh: Two quick fixes: 1) ensure suspend wrapper cancels Call on coroutine cancellation (call.invokeOnCancellation { call.cancel() }), 2) add singleflight for token refresh so only one HTTP refresh happens regardless of timing.

omar: Also consider changing mobile defaults: set retryOnConnectionFailure(false) and force retries into our higher-level retryer which understands idempotency. Streaming calls should be non-retriable by default.

tess: Agree. For UX: we should update the onboarding guide sampleapp to demonstrate proper coroutine cancellation and show auth client separation (small auth-only OkHttpClient) to avoid head-of-line blocking with HTTP/2.

leigh: Small additions to telemetry: tag EventListener cancel reasons (USER_CANCEL, SYSTEM_CANCEL, NETWORK_CHANGE, TIMEOUT) so we can measure how often this is a cancellation-vs-system issue.

ci-bot: Created ticket SDK-3412: "Kotlin sampleapp: coroutine cancellation must cancel OkHttp Call; singleflight token refresh; mobile retry defaults" (<https://issues.redwood/SDK-3412>)

tess: I'll open a tiny PR with: - improved suspend wrapper (cancels call) - singleflight refresh implementation - sampleapp patch and docs blurb. Will attach adb log + repro steps.

omar: Nice. Add small test across Pixel 5/6 and emulator with network flakiness to validate.

leigh: And add a short FAQ entry in onboarding: "Why didn't my cancel stop the request?" with examples.

tess: on it, thanks!
